from __future__ import annotations
import ast,contextlib,json,math,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121/src')
from sdkbench.candidates.adapters import load_adapter,workflow_configuration
from sdkbench.candidates.applications import fixture
from sdkbench.p0 import Bundle
from sdkbench.p0.evaluators import routing
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization import _cz_blocks as blocks
from flagquantum.compiler.optimization.two_qubit_optimization import Matrix,_IDENTITY,_matmul
from flagquantum.core.ir import Instruction
from collections.abc import Sequence
BASE='5a84f706ab9aeaab0ad3a5472bac292616fe39fe'
HARNESS=Path('/private/tmp/sdkbench-product-conformance-20261121')
NONCES=['01'*32]
WORKFLOWS=('flagquantum-ordinary-restored','flagquantum-target-artifact')
BUNDLE=Bundle(HARNESS/'docs/implementation')
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=HARNESS,text=True,timeout=15).strip()=='9aa9260920984e2ca05bcb293abb885fccd9c144'
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=HARNESS,text=True,timeout=15).strip()
BASE_SOURCE=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',BASE+':flagquantum/compiler/optimization/_cz_blocks.py'],text=True,timeout=20)

def sparse_product(instructions:Sequence[Instruction],pair:tuple[int,int],*,matrix_reader:blocks.MatrixReader=blocks._matrix)->Matrix|None:
    result=_IDENTITY
    for instruction in instructions:
        matrix=matrix_reader(instruction,pair)
        if matrix is None:return None
        if not all(math.isfinite(value.real) and math.isfinite(value.imag) for row in matrix for value in row):return None
        rows=[]
        for row in matrix:
            terms=[(index,value) for index,value in enumerate(row) if value!=0]
            if len(terms)==1:
                index,value=terms[0];rows.append([sum((value*entry,)) for entry in result[index]])
            elif len(terms)==2:
                (a,x),(b,y)=terms;rows.append([sum((x*result[a][j],y*result[b][j])) for j in range(4)])
            else:rows=[];break
        result=rows if rows else _matmul(matrix,result)
    return result

def clone(source,name,namespace):
 node=next(node for node in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name==name)
 namespace=dict(namespace);exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[node],type_ignores=[]),'<balanced-'+name+'>','exec'),namespace);return namespace[name]
BASELINE=clone(BASE_SOURCE,'_product',vars(blocks))
CANDIDATE=clone(Path(__file__).read_text(),'sparse_product',globals())
FUNCTIONS={'baseline':BASELINE,'candidate':CANDIDATE}
def adapter_for(workflow):
 config=workflow_configuration(workflow);return load_adapter(SimpleNamespace(configuration={'options':{'sdk':config['sdk'],'workflow':workflow,'compiler_options':config}}))
for workflow in WORKFLOWS:adapter_for(workflow).execute('route',fixture(6,'qft','grid',NONCES[0]),11)
BINDS=[]
for module_name,module in tuple(sys.modules.items()):
 if module is None or not module_name.startswith(('flagquantum.','benchmarks.')):continue
 for name,value in tuple(vars(module).items()):
  if value is blocks._product:BINDS.append((module,name,value))
@contextlib.contextmanager
def selected(variant):
 with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
  for module,name,original in BINDS:
   assert vars(module)[name] is original;stack.enter_context(patch.object(module,name,FUNCTIONS[variant]))
  yield
 for module,name,original in BINDS:assert vars(module)[name] is original

def accept(payload,source):
 width=source['n_qubits'];assert payload['final_layout']==list(range(width))
 case=BUNDLE.cases['ROUTE-GRID-08' if width==8 else f'ROUTE-LINE-{width:02d}'];return routing(payload,source,None,case,0)
